# CatalogStorefront Feed Writer

*Written for humans. Witten by Paul+Fable. 100% Validated by Paul. Do not edit without consent.*

## Feeds: from MySQL to feed rows

*Feeds* created by [magento/commerce-data-export](https://github.com/magento/commerce-data-export)

### Change tracking

1. A write to a trigger table puts the entity id in the *feed*'s mview changelog, or a full rebuild[^full-rebuild] lists every entity.
2. The *feed* indexer runs, on cron or through `indexer:reindex`, and builds the row of every changed entity through the providers.
3. The row is hashed and compared with the hash of its last export in the *feed* table. A row with an equal hash is dropped ([filterFeedItems](https://github.com/magento/commerce-data-export/blob/main/DataExporter/Model/Indexer/FeedIndexProcessorCreateUpdate.php#L324-L372), [isSendNeeded](https://github.com/magento/commerce-data-export/blob/main/DataExporter/Model/Indexer/FeedIndexProcessorCreateUpdate.php#L397-L409)).
4. The remaining rows go to [ExportFeedInterface](https://github.com/magento/commerce-data-export/blob/main/DataExporter/Model/ExportFeedInterface.php#L12) as one batch.

## Writers: from feed rows to OpenSearch documents

[Document\Delivery](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefront/Model/Document/Delivery.php#L17-L31) [implements](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefront/etc/di.xml#L3) [ExportFeedInterface](https://github.com/magento/commerce-data-export/blob/main/DataExporter/Model/ExportFeedInterface.php#L12). Its `writers` argument binds *feeds* to *writers* ([product](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontApi/Storage/ProductDocumentStorageInterface.php#L12) or [metadata](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontApi/Storage/MetadataDocumentStorageInterface.php#L13), [implemented by OpenSearch](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontOpenSearch/etc/di.xml#L3-L6)) and its `identities` argument binds *feeds* to cache tags (see the `di` links in the Writer columns). Its `flags` argument binds a *writer* family to its enable setting: `catalog/storefront_documents/index_enabled`.

- **Writer.** Turns *feed* rows into documents and merges each one into the store with `doc_as_upsert` ([Client](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontOpenSearch/Model/Client.php#L199-L200)); a deleted row is a `delete`. A *writer* can access the incoming documents as well as the document storage itself, but never MySQL. Fundamental for future cloud infrastructure.
- **Success handling.** Delivery answers 200 when every *writer* stored the batch ([export](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefront/Model/Document/Delivery.php#L54-L68)); the *feed* table stores the status per row.
- **Cache purge.** After the write, Delivery dispatches `clean_cache_by_tags` with the identities of the batch, the product and category tags with their ids ([purge](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefront/Model/Document/Delivery.php#L81-L94)).
- **Error handling.** A *writer* failure answers 500; the row is sent again the next time its entity is rebuilt.

[^full-rebuild]: `bin/magento catalog-storefront:rebuild` ([Rebuild](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefront/Console/Command/Rebuild.php#L21-L32)) creates an empty index per store view and moves the `_write` alias onto it ([stage](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontOpenSearch/Model/Index.php#L58-L70)) clears the feed tables of the entity runs the feed indexers moves the read alias to the new index in one step and deletes the old one ([promote](https://github.com/graphcommerce-org/magento2-GraphCommerce_CatalogStorefront/blob/main/src/CatalogStorefrontOpenSearch/Model/Index.php#L76-L91)).
